ROOT.scriptdef: IF EXISTS (SELECT Name,xtype FROM sysobjects WHERE Name='POS_KarDoEksportu' AND xtype in (N'FN', N'IF', N'TF', N'FS', N'FT')) drop function CDN.POS_KarDoEksportu;

CREATE FUNCTION CDN.POS_KarDoEksportu (@PointOfSaleId int,@rowVersion int) RETURNS @knt TABLE ( KarNumer int ) AS BEGIN insert into @knt select distinct kar_gidnumer from cdn.Rejestry join cdn.picostanowiskaformypl on PFP_KARNumer = KAR_GIDNumer join cdn.POS_WanDoEksportu(@pointOfSaleId,@rowVersion) on WanSymbol = KAR_Waluta where PFP_PSaID = @pointOfSaleId AND (KAR_CzasModyfikacji > @rowVersion OR @rowVersion = 0) RETURN END
GRANT SELECT ON CDN.POS_KarDoEksportu TO CDNRaport
